title: Towards Total Recall in Industrial Anomaly Detection (PatchCore)
mechanism: Coreset memory bank of mid-level patch features; nearest-neighbour distance is the anomaly score.
adaptation: Canonical AD row of the benchmark and the bank builder for the WeakREST residual arm; banks per source x layout from clean pool cells; report crack and inactive relF1@2 to show the gap to supervised.
evidence: R: MVTec AD image AUROC up to 99.6 (widely reported; 1996 citations).
min_experiment: Benchmark row, one run per source; no kill line.
